descriptionHtml:
Redragon H540 Luna Wired Gaming Headset Black (Large 53mm Speakers / Extended 15-30KHz Frequency Range / 7.1 Virtual Surround Sound Cable Included / 3.5mm Universal Audio Cable / Detachable Omnidirectional Noise-Canceling Microphone / Lightweight 275g Ergonomic Design / Multi-Platform Support / 1 Year Official Local Agent Warranty)

Elevate your competitive audio experience with the Redragon H540 Luna Wired Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty. Built with high-output 53mm dynamic drivers delivering an extended frequency response from 15Hz to 30kHz, this headset reproduces deep bass tones and clear positional cues. The package includes both a dedicated 7.1 Virtual Surround sound cable for PC immersion and a standard 3.5mm audio cable for multi-platform versatility. Featuring a detachable omnidirectional noise-canceling microphone, a lightweight 275g build, and ergonomic ear cups, the H540 Luna Wired Headset provides outstanding comfort and audio accuracy for PC, console, and mobile gaming setups.
